MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: the obligation is to provide the source of

and in the cargo registry cache for anyone building lievo from source.

## Bundled native components

The crates above include the licence text as declared in their crates.io
metadata. Several `-sys` crates additionally bundle C/C++ sources that are
licensed separately from the crate itself; cargo-about does not see those
bundled files, so their licences are listed here by hand. Each entry names
the `-sys` crate and version that ships the bundled code, and the original
licence text as found in the locked registry source
(`~/.cargo/registry/src/<registry>/<crate>-<version>/...`).

's `https` feature is enabled on Linux targets. lievo depends on `git2 = "0.21"`
with default features only (see `Cargo.toml`), which does not enable `https`;
accordingly `Cargo.lock` contains neither `openssl-sys` nor `libssh2-sys`, so
no OpenSSL-licensed code is compiled into lievo's release binaries.

## Runtime-downloaded model

The embedding model `minishlab/potion-code-16M-v2` is downloaded on demand
(when the semantic index is built) and is licensed MIT.
